_about: Cyclohexane (1) + Propylene glycol (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of cyclohexane, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Z. Zhang, P. Jiang, D. Huang, M. Lv, Y. Du, W. Li, Vapor Liquid Equilibrium for Ternary and Binary Mixtures of Tetrahydrofuran, Cyclohexane, and 1,2-Propanediol at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Eng. Data 58 (2013) 3054-3060
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 14, 15. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.52 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
